range_test_intro: Measure your lowest and highest comfortable pitch, and watch the range shift over time.
range_test_mode_modal_blurb: Modal voice only — the register you actually talk in. This is the one that tracks usable progress.
range_test_mode_modal_high_prompt: Glide upward, but stop before your voice flips or thins out into falsetto. Hold the highest note you can keep in your normal speaking register.
range_test_mode_full_blurb: Everything your voice can produce, falsetto and head voice included. Interesting, but not where you speak.
range_test_mode_full_high_prompt: Glide upward. Falsetto is fine — hold the highest note you can sustain without straining. Stop if it hurts.
range_test_mode_separate_note: These are tracked as separate series — falsetto reads far higher than modal voice, so mixing them into one trend would be meaningless.
range_test_steps_ask_c: . Comfortable means no straining, no pushing — if it hurts or feels forced, it doesn't count.
range_test_warmup_note: Warm up first if you haven't. A cold voice will read lower and narrower than your real range, and you'll only be comparing against yourself later.
range_test_slide_down: Slide down to your lowest comfortable note
range_test_slide_up: Slide up to your highest comfortable note
range_test_low_instructions: Hum or sing "ah", gliding downward. When you reach the lowest note you can hold steadily without it turning into a rattle, hold it there.
range_test_progress_enough: Got enough — keep going, or move on when ready
range_test_progress_keep: Keep sounding until the bar fills
range_test_delta: Low {low} Hz · High {high} Hz · Range {rangeDelta} semitones
range_test_first_test: This is your first {label} test — it becomes the baseline everything later compares against.
range_test_notes_placeholder: Warmed up first? Tired? Anything worth remembering when you compare later.
range_test_history_empty: No range tests yet. Take one now and it becomes your baseline.
range_test_relabel_as_full: Click to relabel as Full range
range_test_relabel_as_modal: Click to relabel as Speaking range
range_test_scale_note: Bars are drawn on a shared {min}–{max} Hz scale. Click a mode label to relabel a test.
